name: Répáshuta (Hungary)
description: Two equal vertical stripes of light grey and green, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Répáshuta: a crowned green and white shield with a glass and a tree, above a scroll inscribed RÉPÁSHUTA.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Répáshuta arms with crown and scroll
